evidence.claim: The absence of significant environmental effects at z > 1 may be an artifact of photo-z uncertainty in density estimation, which could wash out true environmental signals at high redshift.
evidence.excerpt: the "absence of significant environmental effects" observed at $z > 1$ could simply be an artifact of severe projection effects along the line of sight washing out the signal, rather than a genuine lack of physical environmental quenching.
